notes.title: A (pixel) perfect update!
notes.content:
Mostly a graphical update this time. The game is now "pixel perfect" on all resolutions.

Blocks didn't align perfectly sometimes. Sometimes a block was one pixel "off".
I don't know how many people actually saw this, because most people play on higher resolutions. On mobile however, this was very noticable.
Anyway: I had to rebuild every level, so this was one of the more time consuming updates.

Besides the graphics, I made:[list][*] level 49 twice as hard
[*] level 50 a very little bit harder
[/list]

Cheers!

notes.title: The Final Levels Update!
notes.content:
In this final levels update I have now added another 8 levels. Some of them with a new mechanic, some of them familiar but complex. ;-) I'm not telling you what the mechanic is. You'll see it yourself!

At first, this game contained 35 levels. But thanks to the great responses(!), it now contains a total of 50. And personally I think the added 15 are better then original 35.

Thanks for playing!

PS: Another change is that inside the menu, there is now a resolution dropdown plus a full screen checkbox. This is instead of the screen at the start of the game.

notes.title: Update for unitied!
notes.content:
The ESC button now gives the user a menu.

In this menu you can also choose for level selection. 

At the top of every level you can see the level number now.

Working on new (and more difficult) levels at the moment.
